observations: Apple’s total revenue for the most recent fiscal year was higher than the prior year, indicating growth in top‑line sales.
Operating income rose relative to the prior year, suggesting an improvement in core profitability.
Net income also increased year over year, reflecting stronger overall earnings performance.
Diluted earnings per share grew compared with the prior year, pointing to higher earnings attributable to each share.
Cash generated from operating activities was higher than in the prior year, showing stronger cash flow generation from core operations.
Shareholders’ equity expanded, indicating an accumulation of retained earnings and additional capital.
Long‑term debt fell, reducing leverage and improving the balance‑sheet profile.
Free cash flow, derived from operating cash less capital expenditures, was positive, underscoring the company’s ability to fund growth initiatives and shareholder returns.
